Brilliant is a superintelligent tutor for math and coding. Our team of experts from MIT and Harvard has built a world-class personalized learning system. For students from grade 5 to college and beyond – you work through problems with a tutor that sees where you’re stuck, can sketch right on your screen, asks the right questions, and guides you to real a-ha moments. 

Forget memorizing formulas. Brilliant is designed to build real understanding and help you excel. It’s there when you need it, adapts to how you think, and makes learning feel like a fun challenge instead of a chore. 

Master everything from foundational math and algebra to college-level calculus, Python, computer science, AI, neural networks, algorithms, data analysis, physics, and more.

Join over 10 million people using Brilliant to reach their learning goals.

WHY BRILLIANT WORKS

- One-on-one learning for all 
Private tutoring is the most effective way to learn, but it’s expensive, hard to schedule, and out of reach for most families. Brilliant’s tutor works with you one-on-one, every single day, for a fraction of the cost. No scheduling. No waiting. Just learning. 

- Like someone sitting next to you
Brilliant’s tutor can see what’s on your screen and react in real time, from highlighting parts of a problem to creating visualizations that bring hard concepts to life. 

- Expert-crafted curriculum
Every course is crafted by our team of human experts from top institutions around the world. And with new and updated courses added every month, there’s always something new to explore.

- Learning that adapts to you
Brilliant’s tutor personalizes your experience in real time, adjusting to your skill level, filling gaps before they become problems, and helping you build confidence as you go.

- Build true problem-solving skills
Brilliant doesn’t give you answers. It guides you through problems and to your own a-ha moments. So while you’re learning, you’re also building critical thinking and analytical skills – and having fun.

WHAT PEOPLE ARE SAYING

“Koji doesn’t judge. It feels like talking to the most patient teacher.” — Alan

“Going through a lesson with Koji is more active, interactive, and guided than traditional learning.” — Lory

“She read the problem out loud and figured it out on her own — ‘Oh! I know! Never mind, Mom, I got it!’ I'm seeing those breakthroughs more often.” — Arianne
